crossRefs.note: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not…
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

translations.web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
translations.bsb: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
translations.kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
translations.asv: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.
